descriptiveResampling.method: Enumerate all 6^6 resamples of the six paired percent changes with replacement. Record the empirical central 95% range of resampled medians; positive means reduction. This is descriptive and does not establish device-level confidence or causality.

decision.primaryTarget: Streaming main-thread task time per second is 0.17% higher by median paired change; two pairs improve and four regress. The 20% target is unmet.
decision.frameCadence: Streaming p95 gaps are 5.53% lower by median paired change. Three pairs improve, two remain flat and one regresses. The large preliminary gain is not confirmed.
decision.otherStreamingMeasures: Renderer CPU and per-window script time are mixed. Style and layout durations improve in two pairs and regress in four.
decision.idle: Normal idle main-thread work is mixed; reduced-motion idle work is mixed and its maximum gap worsens in four pairs. No uniform idle gain.
decision.retention: Remove the store queue, bulk state action and their specific tests. Preserve all data and the tested build. Keep the independent cancellation invariant under the original per-producer persistence path.
decision.next: Verify the smaller cancellation fix, freeze its assets, then collect fresh attribution before another performance prototype.
